description: Frozen ImageNet ViT-B/16 feature-distance baseline (the original proof of concept). Not a trained change detector.

frozen_before_test_opened.threshold_rule: argmax F1 of ThresholdSweep on validation

protocol.test_used_for: final scoring only; test-optimal threshold reported, not used
protocol.aggregation: global TP/FP/FN/TN over all pixels of the split

poc_minmax.label: Stage 0 - frozen ImageNet ViT-B/16 feature distance, per-tile min-max (as in the original POC)

val_calibrated.label: Stage 0 - frozen ImageNet ViT-B/16 feature distance, calibrated on validation

poc_native_rule.label: Stage 0 - original POC decision rule (per-tile mean + 1.5 std), no tuning
